title: Catalogue intake source identity and one review queue
summary: Accept one transient file or pasted catalogue text into one ordered review queue, preserve literal source-item identity and expose a collective Product name/SKU/Unit readback with explicit Include/Skip. Internal classification may persist as a quiet suggestion/default for later Product Sheet review; it is never a per-row intake chore. There is no pre-result mapping, manual Placement, automatic Related products link or commercial adoption.
steps: Open a session-scoped CatalogueIntakeSession from Add a product list with exactly one source choice: Drop a file or Paste a product list. Retain raw bytes/text only in the active session; persist only a minimum checksum/external reference or text fingerprint after review. Excel/CSV enter review; a selected PDF yields Automatic PDF review · Ready to connect and Choose Excel or CSV, or paste the list, without storage or queue admission.

Render the ordered CatalogueIntakeReviewQueue before any record adoption. Every item keeps a row/text locator and original wording beside only its editable Product name, SKU, Unit and explicit Include/Skip decision, plus duplicate/required-field state. Keep classification/artwork/source as retained evidence or quiet defaults for later Product Sheet review; do not render them as per-row intake work or mapping controls before results.

Use the exact queue states Ready for input, Reading source, Review needed, Ready, Save failed and Added. Each names only its valid recovery: correct, skip, retry, reselect/paste again, return to the unchanged manual draft or open one added SKU.

Create tenant SKU projections only from explicit accepted items, preserving duplicate display names, literal external codes and literal supplied unit evidence. Source grouping may appear as evidence for a reviewable Internal category; it never writes a group or a RelatedItemLink.

Keep source/review seams limited to catalogue.intake.opened, catalogue.intake.source.accepted, catalogue.intake.review.ready, catalogue.intake.item.decided, catalogue.intake.completed and sku.created. They are UI/audit names, not a parser/model/worker/runtime design.

positive: A supported file and pasted catalogue text each enter the same ordered queue, keep original locator/wording visible, and use the same literal review grammar without a mapping screen.
A deterministic fixture can preserve a quiet internal classification suggestion/default without making it a visible per-row review task or claiming an automated source or background process.
An explicitly added item creates one exact SKU whose unit/source/history remain independent and can later be used as one safe Albarán line.
negative: A file/paste, queue acknowledgement, source grouping, automatic result or retry cannot silently rename, merge, create a RelatedItemLink, convert an unknown unit, approve artwork, set price/stock or create an Albarán/customer-visible fact.
Reload, retry, logs, traces, queues, browser caches and IndexedDB cannot retain raw inbound bytes or pasted text; derived review facts cannot impersonate an original source.

doneConditions: Nested E186 journeys pass: single product; file list; pasted list; ready/attention/partial/unavailable/source-unavailable/save-failed/retry/skip recovery; collective Product name/SKU/Unit plus Include/Skip readback; duplicate protection; no automatic relation; later Product Sheet classification/artwork review; later explicit Add variation; and accepted SKU exact-Albarán use.
Desktop and phone task-frame proofs cover 1920×1080, 1536×864, 1366×768, 360×800, 390×844 and 393×873 with keyboard, touch, Back/Forward, reload/interruption and phone-keyboard recovery.
requiredEvidence: File-and-paste intake state drive with source-custody scan, state screenshots and no-mapping-before-results assertion.
Deterministic-review fixture trace, unavailable-review trace, explicit SKU confirmation/idempotency trace, direct-relation noncreation trace and exact-Albarán use trace.

Create a RelatedItemLink only through the reviewed inline Related products picker between two existing coded SKU or accepted uncoded records; it never opens New product or creates an SKU. Allow corrected enrichment only through reviewable adoption commands separate from order reasoning. Ordinary New product/file/paste review may be created with Internal category Not organised and has no Related-products candidate step or automatic category/group write.

A reviewed mapped variation preserves the base-item/note or approved-variation distinction, its approval evidence and its customer-visible document consequence.

An off-SKU phrase, recurrence, category, customer, source grouping, similarity or relation cannot silently admit or promote an UncodedSaleItem or make it a SKU/ERP/stock/tariff master.
